_comment: Mapperatorinator (OliBomby/Mapperatorinator, MIT; weights OliBomby/Mapperatorinator-v32, MIT) makes the charts (docs/MAPPERATORINATOR.md). It runs in its own Python, set up on first use under the runtime folder: uv (from PyPI), Python 3.11, PyTorch with CUDA and Mapperatorinator's inference packages, its source (bundled with the app, else from GitHub at the pinned commit) and the weights (Hugging Face).

fx._comment: FX notes of 4K+FX and 6K+FX (server/rhythm_server/mapper/fx.py): the model makes these as 4K and 6K, and the tier's sideRate (config/difficulty.json) times rateScale of the note instants are moved to the FX lanes, holdShare of them holds (the model's own, minHoldBeats long at least), the rest taps on the strongest hits; FX notes are minGapMs apart at least. enabled false leaves the FX lanes empty.

silence._comment: Silences of the song's audio (server/rhythm_server/mapper/silence.py): a stretch of minMs or more under the song's loud level by belowLoudDb (or under floorDb dBFS), measured in frames of frameMs. Mapperatorinator is asked to stop at the music's end plus endPadMs when the song ends in one, and a note more than marginMs into a silence is dropped (a hold reaching into one ends there).

lora._comment: LoRA adapters by key count (server/rhythm_server/mapper/lora.py, docs/MAPPER_LORA.md). The adapter of <N>K is the folder lora/<N>K in the runtime folder (%LOCALAPPDATA%\Generative Rhythm\mapper\lora\8K), holding adapter_config.json and adapter_model.safetensors; adapters names another folder for a key count ({"8K": "8K-v2"}: under lora/, or an absolute path). 4K+FX and 6K+FX use 4K's and 6K's. enabled false: the base model for every key count. A chart made with an adapter holds its tag in its id and in meta.generator.lora.

conditions._comment: The model's other conditions by key count, none by default ({"8K": {"negativeDescriptors": ["style/N+1"], "cfgScale": 2.0}}): descriptors and negativeDescriptors (style tags of the model's 122), cfgScale (over 1: classifier-free guidance, the decoder runs twice a token), columnTemperature, mapperId, year. They are part of the chart id. docs/MAPPER_LORA.md.

camera._comment: The camera's cues from a chart's own notes (server/rhythm_server/chart/camera_notes.py). cameraFrom: "notes" (this, no song analysis) or "structure" (the analysed sections, as before). Sections are cut where the notes per beat of the next windowBars bars differ from the last ones' by `change` (of the song's busy level: the topPercentile of its bars) at least, minBars apart (a busier section starts at the first bar within plateauSlack of its usual level); a section of busyEnergy or more among the sections is a busy one (it leans and pulses). Bars that each fill up by rampStep before a busy section, rampBars at most, are a build-up; so is a stream of streamBeats or more (hits no further apart than streamGapBeats) ending before the next section.

_starsForLevelByMode: The star rating a rating is asked at, by the key count the model makes (4K+FX and 6K+FX as 4K and 6K): [rating, stars] points, joined by straight lines (12.5 is the middle of level 12; a tier aims at the middle of its range). Fitted to the level the app measures of the model's charts (docs/MAPPERATORINATOR.md, "난이도 구간에 맞추기"); starsForLevel is for a key count not here.

levelFit._comment: A chart's level must be in its tier's range (server/rhythm_server/mapper/fit.py): one outside it is made again, at most `attempts` charts in all, at the stars a secant in log stars and log rating gives (slope until two tries give theirs, kept within minSlope..maxSlope; a step moves the stars by maxStep at most; stars within minStars..maxStars); the last still too high is thinned (the weakest notes out), all too low leave the song without the tier.
